name: Vera Blanc
source: By 14 years old she had graduated from university as a child prodigy. After being diagnosed with brain cancer her father's wealth bought her experimental surgery. This gave her an even better memory and processing capacity. It also gave her the telepathic power to read others surface thoughts which her father encouraged her to kept secret.
